query: WITH duplicate_pairs AS (SELECT latitude, longitude FROM public.providers WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(status, 'active'))) = 'active' AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY latitude, longitude HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) UPDATE public.providers p SET latitude = NULL, longitude = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(p.status, 'active'))) = 'active' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM duplicate_pairs d WHERE d.latitude = p.latitude AND d.longitude = p.longitude) RETURNING p.id, p.provider_name;
